meta.title: Dearlly — say it like a love letter
meta.description: Love notes, date invitations, vacation surprises and gift reveals, sealed and sent by private link. Plus games for two.

brand.name: Dearlly
brand.tagline: Sealed with love, sent by link.

home.title: Say it like a love letter.
home.lead: Love notes, date invitations, vacation surprises and gift reveals — sealed in an envelope and sent by private link. Plus games for two.

art.label: A love letter peeking out of a kraft envelope sealed with red wax
art.body: Dinner at the lagoon, Saturday at 7?

loveNote.title: Love note
loveNote.body: A few true words, sealed with wax.

date.title: Date invitation
date.body: Ask them out properly, with a time and a place.

vacation.title: Vacation invite
vacation.body: Pack the bags first, then tell them.

gift.title: Gift reveal
gift.body: They scratch the stamp to see it.

home.gamesBody: Answer privately, reveal together. From talking stage to deep talk — the server deals the questions, so nobody can peek.

login.title: Log in or sign up
login.lead: Log in with an emailed code, or your password if you've set one.
login.humanCheck: Quick check that you're a person:
login.codeLead: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. It works once and expires in 10 minutes.
login.differentEmail: Use a different email or get a new code
login.signupLead: Your username is public. Your email is never shown to anyone.
login.usernameHint: 3–20 letters, numbers or _ , starting with a letter.
login.methodLabel: How do you want to log in?
login.forgotPassword: Forgot your password? Get a code instead
login.newPasswordHint: At least 10 characters. Skip it and you can always log in with a code.
login.googleFailed: Google sign-in didn't work. Please try again, or use an emailed code.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.deleteBody: This permanently deletes your account, your profile and everything linked to it, and logs you out on every device. It can't be undone.
profile.passwordNone: You log in with emailed codes. Add a password if you'd like another way in.
profile.passwordSet: You can log in with your password or an emailed code.
profile.newPasswordHint: At least 10 characters. Changing it logs you out on your other devices.

loginPanel.quote: Every love story deserves a proper letter.

write.title: Write a love note
write.lead: Fill it in, watch it come together, then seal it.
write.titleHint: e.g. my love, babe, sunshine. Used as "Dear …".
write.emailHint: We'll email them the link (when it opens, if you set a time). Up to 10 a day. Used only for this letter.
write.pickQuote: Pick a quote to start from
write.scheduleLabel: Keep it sealed until (optional, Lagos time)
write.scheduleHint: Leave empty to open straight away. Great for 00:00 on 14 February.
write.sealNeedsAccount: You'll log in or create a free account at this step. Your letter is kept while you do.
write.sealedLead: Your letter is ready. Only people with this link can open it.
write.whatsappText: I wrote you something 💌 Open it here:
write.trackIt: You'll see when it's opened and their reply on your profile.
write.emailScheduled: We'll email it to {email} within a minute.
write.emailWhenOpens: We'll email it to {email} when it opens.
write.emailBlocked: We can't email this address. Share the link instead.

letter.notFound: This letter doesn't exist or was taken back by the sender.
letter.breakHint: Tap the envelope or the button to open it.
letter.envelopeLabel: Sealed letter for {name} from {sender}. Tap to open.
letter.senderNote: This is your letter, exactly as they'll see it. Opening it here doesn't count as Opened.
letter.senderNoReply: No reply yet. It will show here and on your profile.
letter.replyLead: Let {sender} know how this made you feel.
letter.writeBackLead: Dearlly is free. Make one for someone you love.
letter.reportLead: Tell us what's wrong. The sender won't know it was you.
letter.reportThanks: Thank you. We'll look at it. If it came by email, you can also stop emails from this sender with the link at the bottom of that email.

sent.title: Letters you've sent
sent.revoked: Taken back: the link no longer works
sent.takeBackConfirm: Take it back? The link will stop working for good.
sent.emailWhenOpens: Will be emailed when it opens
sent.emailFailed: Couldn't email it: share the link instead
sent.emailBlocked: Not emailed: share the link instead

save.heading: Keep this letter
save.failed: Couldn't save it on this browser. Try a screenshot instead.
save.qrLine: Make one for someone you love

unsubscribe.title: Your emails from Dearlly
unsubscribe.lead: Dearlly only emails you when someone sends you a letter. Choose what you'd like:
unsubscribe.stopSenderHint: Others can still email you letters.
unsubscribe.neverHint: No letters from anyone, ever. People can still share a link with you themselves.
unsubscribe.doneSender: Done. You won't get any more emails from {sender}.
unsubscribe.doneAll: Done. Dearlly will never email you again.
